name: @polymech/pm-xblox
description: XBlox flow runtime and the pm-xblox CLI. The Tanit host compiles the engine and keeps settings, branding, and command registration.

scripts.build:cpp: npm run configure && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset dev --target pm-xblox
scripts.build:cpp:release: npm run configure:release && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset release --target pm-xblox
